Jamal Reyes: Aperture signed the beta invite but emailed two asks: (1) can we lock region to DE for data residency, (2) they'd like a custom enablement focused on fine-grained access controls.
Priya Nair: Noted. I've got a 45m slot available Tue/Wed mornings. Should we make it 60m to cover controls + hands-on?
Evan Brooks: Recommend 60m. We'll demo role-based keys, scoped prompts, and show the audit log export. Bring the short runbook.
Kai Müller: On region pinning: infra requires a region tag on the tenant and a routing policy. I can request DE pinning but need an org-id from sales.
Jamal Reyes: I pinged Sales for org-id and legal contact. Also procurement wants an example sanitized audit log for their security team.
Evan Brooks: Example sanitized log below:
```
{"event":"auth","user":"[REDACTED]","role":"admin","action":"token_create","ts":"2026-01-15T09:12:34Z"}
```
Priya Nair: I'll draft the session agenda: 15m overview, 30m hands-on access control lab, 15m Q&A + next steps. Will include a short post-session micro-survey.
Jamal Reyes: For feedback capture, let's keep it lightweight: 3 quick items: usefulness (1-5), any blocker (y/n + short), request follow-up (y/n). If they flag a blocker, auto-open CS ticket and tag renewal-risk.
Kai Müller: Region pin request submitted to infra with org-id placeholder. ETA 24h for confirmation. If DE can't be pinned immediately, fallback = hosted EU routing with SLA note.
pilot-bot: Reminder: Aperture enablement scheduled by Priya Nair. Use /pilot-survey to attach the post-session questions and auto-create tickets on blocker.
Evan Brooks: Also requested a sample prompt pack focused on access control scenarios. I'll post in the drive. Link: https://redwood.app/drive/pilots/aperture/access-prompts

Priya Nair: Sent invite for Wed 2026-01-20 09:00 CET (60m). Included pre-read and the audit-log example.
Jamal Reyes: Action items: Kai confirm DE pinning or fallback, Priya run the 60m enablement + survey, Evan post prompt pack & run lab, I'll monitor survey and open tickets for blockers. I'll add a renewal-risk flag if we get 2 or more blocker signals in the first week.
Kai Müller: Infra confirmed DE tenant pinning is scheduled; provisioning window tomorrow. Will update if any delay.
